assessment.report:
# Adaptive concurrency readiness

Bounded scope: raise the optional recommended child-thread ceiling from three to six, excluding Lead; normal two-to-three guidance is not a minimum. Medium and large work may increase concurrency only for ready independent tasks with distinct outputs, explicit write boundaries and integration. Respect actual enforced capacity even below source recommendation; no recursive delegation, forced quota, premature dependent work, weakened role/review obligations, global configuration edit or model change is authorized.

The Lead read repository instructions, complete README pair, architecture/release rules and shared role, ownership, execution, testing, TDD and comment contracts. Default inventory boundaries remain unchanged; out-of-scope designs/results remain preserved and are not re-certified. Chinese README/changelog, config, Skills and focused tests outside default inventory are explicit dependencies. No applicable product PRD or OpenSpec opt-in governs this repository maintenance task. Existing structure is adequate; no Blueprint amendment or source reorganization is needed.

Ownership: docs maintainer owns canonical role routing, team-dev/team-review step routes and paired public summaries/release item; backend owns only optional recommended config; Tester owns focused isolated config tests and the canonical packet; independent Reviewer inspects the coherent final implementation. These exact roles exist in the active tool catalog. Initial two child creation calls used team-tester and team-docs-maintainer; backend creation was rejected by capacity with no ID. Queue the same named role when available, without generic fallback. Tool-selected role and handle are not independently resolved model identity.

The official configuration guide confirms open spawned-child-thread semantics and primary exclusion. Source cap6 does not prove host availability or immediate activation. Test runs use repeatable programmatic entrypoints and summary-first results, with fixture cleanup; real-agent six-thread behavior and user acceptance remain pending. No exact personal paths are published. This readiness review binds inspected facts and sufficient approved scope, not global correctness, execution guarantees or manual acceptance.

The Lead inspected the complete Tester-created packet and narrow configuration test before writer authorization. AC-01 is an observable source-fragment test-first check, not a resolved Codex configuration test. AC-02 through AC-06 include explicit runtime checkpoints/manual mapping; semantic walkthroughs do not become E2E passes.

Tester observed genuine pre-writer Red: the actual agents table value was three against required six; reader self-fixtures passed, the source hash was unchanged and the owned temporary root was removed. Packet validation passed. No production edits preceded this observation.

## Final implementation and verification

The recommended fragment now contains `max_concurrent_threads_per_session = 6`; model/effort/enabled/interrupt values are unchanged. Canonical role-routing defines session-wide open-child-thread counting with Lead excluded, typical two-to-three guidance (not a required minimum), medium three-to-four and large four-to-six only for ready independent tasks within actual host capacity. Above three, Lead explains to the user and records outputs, dependencies, nonoverlapping write boundaries and integration in existing records. A capacity-only failure may queue the same exact named role and permit one bounded retry after meaningful progress without a capacity report; no blind retry, identity fallback, recursion, ownership conflict or premature dependent work is authorized. Other spawn/role/identity errors retain the existing user-decision path. Team-dev/team-review route to that single rule; public English/Chinese summaries and one current 0.9.3 release item are synchronized. This focused extension retains the unreleased 0.9.3 source line; no promotion or local deployment occurred.

Tester observed genuine pre-writer Red at source value three, then Green at six, with section-aware decoys, original-value observation, seven unsupported/ambiguous fixtures, unchanged source hash and verified cleanup. Final documentation validator, isolated bilingual suite, native package validator, isolated package regression and fake-home installation suite passed. Install test callers explicitly supply both temporary homes; the exact owned install root was independently confirmed absent. Every in-scope test has scenario/expected-result comments supported by assertions; the declarative config has sufficient purpose/merge/capacity comments and no callable-interface obligation. No whole-project annotation was performed.

Independent Reviewer found no material findings after semantic small/medium/large, lower/unknown capacity, bounded retry, missing-role, dependency/shared-state and review-only walkthroughs. Reviewer independently reran focused configuration/document/native checks. English/Chinese changed facts are equivalent and historical English release sections remain unchanged. A nonblocking first-time manual-merge sentence suggestion was left unchanged because the linked config already gives explicit merge instructions. Main inspected actual source and packet evidence, reconciled privacy and ownership, and authorizes closure of this bounded implementation, not runtime/manual acceptance.

## Final actual roster and limits

- `/root/concurrency_docs` — selected `team-docs-maintainer`; canonical instructions and paired public docs; complete.
- `/root/concurrency_config` — selected `team-backend-engineer`; only recommended config; complete.
- `/root/concurrency_tester` — selected `team-tester`; pre-writer packet, Red/Green, isolated regression verification; complete.
- `/root/concurrency_reviewer` — selected `team-reviewer`; independent read-only semantic/source review; complete.

One initial config-role creation was rejected for thread capacity with no ID; later the same exact named-role retry succeeded after planning progress. No alternative role, created retry identity or recursive child was hidden. Returned handles/selectors do not independently establish loaded role/model identity; unreported runtime metadata stay unknown. The actual host rejected a third child despite catalog slot guidance; no durable free-slot count or actual support for six is inferred. This task's stage packet remains active with `manual pending`. No commit, push, real installation or global configuration edit occurred. Earlier unrelated scoped reviews may be stale after inventory changes; they are not refreshed or re-certified. Final RecordReview binds the inspected current evidence and scope only.
